# Scope and Rules — Files.com

This file is a working checklist based on the program policy supplied by the user.

## Authorized
- In-scope assets explicitly listed by the program.
- Researcher-created Files.com trial site using the required [BUGBOUNTY] marker and HackerOne alias.
- Test users and test data created by the researcher.
- Reproducible authorization/authentication/security-boundary tests inside that environment.
- Reasonable AI assistance, subject to the program's confidentiality, scope, stopping, and rate rules.

## Prohibited / stop conditions
- No testing of Files.com customer sites, accounts, or customer data.
- No scanning/probing arbitrary *.files.com customer subdomains.
- No DoS, spam, brute force, phishing, social engineering, or physical attacks.
- Max 2 requests/second total across automated testing.
- Do not use the in-app AI Assistant during testing.
- If customer data is encountered: stop that path, do not send it to AI/third parties, remove captured copies.
- For code execution: harmless fixed-string/arithmetic proof only, then stop.
- Never store or transmit passwords, API keys, cookies, session tokens, recovery codes, or secrets in this audit.

## Reporting
- One issue per report.
- Include reproducible steps and expected documented security boundary.
- Keep evidence minimal and relevant.
- Do not use Burp Suite screenshots/scanner output/intercepted request-response captures as report evidence.
- User must review any AI-assisted report before submission.

Status: PLANNED

Safety: own trial site, own folder, own user/data only.

Expected: server rejects operation due to destination permissions.
Safety: own test files only.

### TC-AUTH-004 — Cross-folder read/copy from forbidden folder

Expected: denied.

Status: PLANNED

Constraint: do not record API keys in audit files.
